title: Update on Review of Appropriate Adult Scheme for Young Suspects
what_it_is: Update on Review of Appropriate Adult Scheme for Young Suspects

sections.label: Appropriate Adult Scheme age expansion
sections.summary: Young suspects are interviewed with a trained volunteer under AAYS, whose age threshold rises from April 2023 to include 16- and 17-year-olds, targeted for completion by October 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Young suspects are interviewed by the Police in the presence of an independent and trained volunteer under the Appropriate Adult Scheme for Young Suspects (AAYS).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The current age threshold of AAYS is 16.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From April 2023, we will be increasing the age threshold to include 16-year-olds and 17-year-olds and will target to complete the expansion by October 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This can only be done when the number of AA volunteers is increased and we are now working to build up the AA volunteer pool.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police will notify parents on the arrest and investigation of young suspects at the earliest time possible, unless doing so could jeopardise investigations.

sections.label: Appropriate Adult role
sections.summary: The Appropriate Adult is a neutral and independent party who provides emotional support to interviewees and facilitates communication.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: AA is a neutral and independent party who provides emotional support to the interviewees and facilitates communication.

sections.label: Parents excluded as Appropriate Adults
sections.summary: Parents of suspects will not be allowed to be the Appropriate Adult where they have or are perceived to have a conflict of interest.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The parents of the suspects may have conflict of interest, or may be perceived to have a conflict of interest.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, we will not allow parents of the suspects themselves to be the AA in those circumstances.
